question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"times."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Times"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• **"Times"** means periods of minutes, hours, days, etc. (समय, वक्त (मिनटों, घंटों, दिनों आदि में मापी जाने वाली अवधि))
 
 
• **Example:** *There were **times__** when I missed him.*
 
 
 
• It is grammatically correct and fits the context of the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
 
• **Correct passage**:

There are __**times**__ when everyone has to face grief. When someone dear to oneself dies, one is left in a state in which shock and grief ______ (2) ______ ordinary life. One is left in a situation when one feels there is nothing one can do. Grief and mourning are not always associated with death. It also happens with other types of losses. It could be the loss of one’s job, loss of one’s house or the loss of a close friend or a partner. 

The best people who are able to cope with these are those, who come from cultures that have strict, formal ______ (3) ______ intensive mourning rituals. In India, we have diverse rituals which nowadays are being discarded. But these help in the crisis. The near and dear ones come to share their grief and apply balm with their words of solace. In mourning, it is an essential part of coming ______ (4) ______ terms with loss. There comes a time when one has to give up one’s grief and rejoin the mainstream of life. Mourning in itself passes through these phases. Firstly, it is in the nature of shock and disbelief. A feeling of numbness overtakes me. The brain is not in a position to ______ (5) ______, it so happens that one expects the arrival of a loss thinking that nothing will change and he will be with the lost one. In the second phase, one realises the truth that the loss has actually happened, and was not a dream. It is now that one feels the pain. Now one recollects the old moments and the memory of guilt creeps in.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **"time"**, is a singular unit of measurement for time and does not match with the plural subject of the sentence.
 
• Option 2, **"jiffies"**, is a computer science term referring to a small unit of time used in operating systems. (पल; क्षण)
 
• Option 3, **"flashes"**, could potentially refer to a measurement of time, but it is not a commonly used term in this context. (थोड़े समय के लिए कुछ दिखाना)
